request.style: English, solemn male baritone solo with choir, organ, cello, timpani, harp, low brass, grave and majestic, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I gave you empty stomachs in all your cities
Lack of bread in all your places, yet you refused
I withheld the rain when harvest was near
Sent it on one city, but not on another

[Verse]
Fields staggered for water but found no relief
Blight and mildew struck your gardens and trees
Locusts devoured figs and vines you loved
Plagues went out as they did to Egypt

[Verse]
Your young men killed by the sword, horses taken
Stench of camps rose into your nostrils
I overthrew you like Sodom and Gomorrah
A charred stick snatched from the fire

[Verse]
Yet you did not return to me, declares the Lord
Therefore I will do this to you, Israel
Prepare yourself to meet your God, Israel
He who forms the mountains and creates the wind

[Outro]
The LORD, the God of hosts, is his name
